text:
Maya (AE): OK kicking off joint POC with Skyport. They want a staging tenant, SAML SSO, and egress rules. Timeline ask: tenant by Wed. Also need a quick cost estimate for ~10k req/day and answers for their security questionnaire.
Ben (SE): copy. do we have the partner org id? and do they plan hosted or dedicated for the POC?
Cara (Skyport PM): hey! org id is SKY-IGN-42. For the trial we prefer hosted to move faster, but we'll test latency. IP allowlist and SAML will be mandatory.
Dan (NetEng): noted. need to know whether egress goes to their cloud (aws account) or on-prem. if cloud, do they need fixed IPs/NAT? also will SAML be IdP-initiated or SP-initiated?
Cara (Skyport PM): egress -> our AWS account (we'll share subnet + CIDR). SAML: SP-initiated preferred.
Ben (SE): quick pricing rough calc: 10k req/day * ~30 tokens = ~300k tokens/day -> ~9M tokens/month. Hosted pricing ballpark (gpt-large equiv) ~ $0.0004/token -> ~$3.6k/mo. With partner commit / co-sell discount could push to ~$2.4k. Dedicated would need a reserve and infra lead time.
Maya (AE): great — we'll present both hosted POC and a dedicated quote. who can field the security Q? Evelyn?
Evelyn (SecEng): I can take the questionnaire. send the doc link and I'll start populating. quick flags: need to know data residency, retention policy for KV cache, and whether logs will be exported to their SIEM.
Cara (Skyport PM): data residency: US only for POC. retention: default 30 days but we can discuss. SIEM: they'll consume logs via syslog/HTTPS.
Dan (NetEng): for egress, they'll need our outbound IPs listed. infra-bot, can you reserve 3 static NAT IPs in us-west-2 for this tenant?
infra-bot: provisioning NAT IPs and staging tenant for org SKY-IGN-42. tenant id t-2712345678-stg created. Reserved IPs: 34.201.12.45, 34.201.12.46, 34.201.12.47.
Maya (AE): perfect. Cara — please share the AWS account + subnet CIDR and your SAML metadata. I'll drop them in the questionnaire doc.
Cara (Skyport PM): sharing now: https://share.skyport.com/infra/sky-ign-42 (contains account id + subnet). SAML metadata: attached to the form.
Ben (SE): testing plan for latency: we'll run 5k concurrent short prompts and measure p50/p95. If hosted p95 < 400ms we're good. If not, we'll propose a small dedicated pool for the POC.
Evelyn (SecEng): a few answers so far: Encryption at rest: AES-256 (KMS). In-transit: TLS1.2+. Key management: standard KMS; if they require HSM, that's a private deployment conversation.
Maya (AE): note for pricing call: Skyport asked about seat-based integration fee for the co-sell. my thought: waive integration fee for POC, include it in expansion contract.
Cara (Skyport PM): that would help speed legal. thanks.
Dan (NetEng): quick firewall rule snippet for their ops team:
```
allow tcp 443 from 34.201.12.45/32 to service-subnet
allow tcp 443 from 34.201.12.46/32 to service-subnet
allow tcp 443 from 34.201.12.47/32 to service-subnet
```
Send them that and they can add to AWS NACLs.
Ben (SE): I'll prep an SLO doc for the POC (target p50/p95 and throughput baselines) and a simple runbook for failover to a fallback model if capacity spikes.
Maya (AE): action items: 1) Evelyn to fill questionnaire (Evelyn). 2) Ben to send SLO/runbook. 3) Dan to confirm firewall + NAT details. 4) Maya to produce hosted vs dedicated pricing two-line summary. 5) Cara to confirm AWS details and attach legal contact.
Evelyn (SecEng): I started the questionnaire: https://docs.redwood/sec-qna/SKY-IGN-42 (comments on data retention + incident response sections).
infra-bot: tenant t-2712345678-stg is ready with admin user maya@redwood.com.
Cara (Skyport PM): we validated the reserved IPs and added the rules. legal contact: legal@skyport.com. we'll be available for a sync Thurs 11am PT.
Maya (AE): great — locking Thurs 11am PT. Ben, Dan, Evelyn please join. I'll send calendar invite with agenda: tenant access, SAML test, latency baseline, pricing.
Ben (SE): on it. I'll prepare a short demo script for the meeting and link load test harness.
Dan (NetEng): I'll be there for networking checks.
Evelyn (SecEng): will join for the security Q&A.
Maya (AE): thanks all. keeping thread for updates. :handshake:
